group.name: pm_edit
group.title: PM Edit Settings
group.description: Settings for the PM Edit plugin.

enabled.title: Enable PM Editing
enabled.description: Enable or disable the PM editing feature globally.

edittimelimit.title: Edit Time Limit
edittimelimit.description: Number of minutes after receiving/sending a PM that users can still edit it. Set to 0 for unlimited time.

allowed_groups.title: Allowed Usergroups
allowed_groups.description: Select which usergroups can edit their private messages.

allow_edit_received.title: Allow Editing Received PMs
allow_edit_received.description: Allow users to edit PMs they have received. If disabled, users can only edit PMs they have sent.

allow_edit_sent.title: Allow Editing Sent PMs
allow_edit_sent.description: Allow users to edit PMs they have sent. Note: This only affects the sender's copy of the PM.

hard_edit_sent.title: Allow Hard Editing Sent PMs
hard_edit_sent.description: When enabled, editing a sent PM will also edit the recipient's copy. This is useful for moderators to correct messages.

hard_edit_sent_groups.title: Hard Edit Allowed Usergroups
hard_edit_sent_groups.description: Select which usergroups can use hard editing (editing recipient's copy).

track_edits.title: Track Edit History
track_edits.description: Enable to keep a history of all PM edits. This allows users to view previous versions of edited PMs.

show_edit_notice.title: Show Edit Notice
show_edit_notice.description: Display a notice on edited PMs showing when and by whom the PM was last edited.

allow_edit_reason.title: Allow Edit Reason
allow_edit_reason.description: Allow users to provide a reason for editing their PMs.

max_edit_history.title: Max Edit History Entries
max_edit_history.description: Maximum number of edit history entries to keep per PM. Set to 0 for unlimited. Older entries will be deleted.

exclude_folders.title: Excluded Folders
exclude_folders.description: Comma-separated list of folder IDs where PM editing is not allowed. Default: 3 (Drafts), 4 (Trash)

quick_sceditor.title: Use Editor in Quick Edit
quick_sceditor.description: Enable to use the full BBCode editor in PM quick edit instead of plain textarea.
